slots.title: Your AI *front office*
slots.body: For service businesses that lose work to missed calls and slow replies.

slots.title: On the tools *or* on the phone?
slots.body: When you're with a client, the next enquiry waits. And while it waits, the customer is free to ask someone else.

slots.title: Answers the *phone*
slots.body: Built to pick up, understand what the caller needs and book them in, or take a message for you.
points: Hands the call to you when needed

slots.title: Replies to *enquiries*
slots.body: Built to reply quickly, ask the questions you'd ask and offer times that suit.

slots.title: Your rules, your *calendar*
slots.body: Choose how much it does on its own.
points: Owner approval: it asks you first
Enquiry only: it takes the details

slots.title: Launching *soon*
slots.body: Both are in sandbox testing today, not live yet. We're building VENTRA in Australia and sharing the progress here.
